output.answer: Bath & Body Works is owned by Bath & Body Works, Inc. (NYSE: BBWI), a standalone, publicly traded company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio — it has no larger parent company. The company was formerly L Brands, Inc.; it was renamed Bath & Body Works, Inc. effective August 2, 2021, when its Victoria's Secret business was spun off into a separate independent public company (Victoria's Secret & Co.).
caveats: "Parent company" here means the corporate owner of the Bath & Body Works retail brand: that is Bath & Body Works, Inc., a public company whose stock is dispersed among shareholders, so there is no controlling parent — Bath & Body Works, Inc. is the top of its corporate structure.

Older references naming L Brands, Inc. as the owner are outdated: L Brands was renamed Bath & Body Works, Inc. on August 2, 2021, and its Victoria's Secret business no longer has any ownership tie to it.

key_facts.fact: As of its most recent annual report (fiscal year ended January 31, 2026), Bath & Body Works, Inc. is the registrant and ultimate parent of the Bath & Body Works brand; there is no larger parent company above it.

Bath & Body Works, Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated public company headquartered at Three Limited Parkway, Columbus, Ohio 43230; its common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol BBWI, with 201,134,265 shares outstanding as of March 6, 2026.

The company was formerly L Brands, Inc.; its board approved renaming it Bath & Body Works, Inc. (ticker LB → BBWI), effective August 2, 2021, in connection with separating the Victoria's Secret business into an independent public company, Victoria's Secret & Co.
